f3_program: observe(at("orange_bags.reference.weight", "current"), 24, "pound", source("12 bags of oranges weigh 24 pounds"))
product_relation(at("orange_bags.reference.weight", "current"), at("orange_bags.reference.count", "current"), "orange_bags.weight_per_bag", source("12 bags of oranges weigh 24 pounds"))
assumptions: All bags of oranges have the same weight, as implied by applying the reference bag rate to the requested bags.

f3_program: collection("family_farm.oranges_picked_by_nora", "orange", "family_farm", source("She picks 80 oranges from one tree, 60 from another tree, and 120 from the third tree"))

transfer("pick_from_one_tree", "nora", at("family_farm.one_tree.oranges.count", "current"), at("family_farm.oranges_picked_by_nora.count", "current"), 80, source("She picks 80 oranges from one tree"))
transfer("pick_from_third_tree", "nora", at("family_farm.third_tree.oranges.count", "current"), at("family_farm.oranges_picked_by_nora.count", "current"), 120, source("120 from the third tree"))
assumptions: The picked-orange collection is defined by the three stated picking events and is initially empty.

f3_program: observe(at("matt.route.house_to_end.distance", "current"), 1000, "foot", source("he rode a total of 1000 feet"))
observe(at("matt.route.house_to_first_sign.distance", "current"), 350, "foot", source("a stop sign that was 350 feet away from his house"))

offset(at("matt.route.house_to_end.distance", "current"), at("matt.route.house_to_second_sign.distance", "current"), 275, "foot", source("After passing the second sign he road an additional 275 feet"))
assumptions: Matt starts at the house and continues along the same route away from it, so the ride distances locate both signs along that route.
